newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania sells one-year T-bills at 11.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania sells one-year T-bills at 11.85 pct.

text.p: Lithuania sold some 30 million litas ($7.5 million) of one-year Treasury bills on Monday at an average yield of 11.85 percent, the central bank said.
It was the first sale of one-year bills since Merrill Lynch last year bought 200 million litas of 365-day paper at an average 20.125 percent.

The settlement date for the auction is January 30, and the bills mature on January 30, 1998. The next auction is for 50 million litas of 91-day paper on January 28.
